AMENDMENT 
 
 to the Loan Agreement dated 14 November 2018 (“Loan Agreement”), by and between 
 
 Zameen Developments (Private) Limited (“ Zameen ”) and EMPG Holdings Limited (“ EMPG ”) 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 This amendment (“ Amendment ”) to the Loan Agreement, is made and entered into on this 4 th day of July 2022 (“ Execution Date ”), by and between the Parties. 
 
 NOW , THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 The Amendment shall be effective from the Execution Date. 
 
 The Parties agree that the Loan extended may be converted to equity shares of the Borrower on the request of the Lender, subject to applicable laws . In this regard, s hares will be issued against the Pakistan Rupee equivalent of the Loan amount ( including any accrued interest ) outstanding at the time in accordance with the terms and conditions agreed between the Parties. Provided that the shares issued shall not be issued below the latest break-up value. 
 
 This Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Loan Agreement. 
 
 All other terms and provisions in the Loan Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of this Amendment shall prevail and any conflicting term in the Loan Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 
 All expression and terms defined or used in the Loan Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this Amendment, unless otherwise specified.
